command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1's Fix contradicts its own Impact. The Impact says the stable credit requirement 'refers to legends that no longer exist', but the Fix changes only the requirement body ('larger than the group legends' → 'larger than the group captions') and says 'Keep every scenario text as it is'. After archiving, the restated scenario 'The larger credit text' (openspec/specs/settings/spec.md:396: 'the credit text is larger than the group legends and smaller than the "Settings" heading') would still name the removed legends and disagree with its own body. The stated reason (keeping the feature-file step texts matching) is not a real constraint: renaming the step in packages/client/src/test/features/settings/settings_factory_credit_e2e.feature:102 and settings_factory_credit_layout_e2e.steps.ts:81 is within the implement stage's limits (handoff.md: 'It writes under `packages/`'). The Fix should also reword that scenario line to 'group captions' and rename the step text in task 6.3 to match, and its Fix risk should say so.

findings.message: Missed WARNING-level contradiction with a stable spec: openspec/specs/settings/spec.md:422 (Requirement: Interface language choice, not in the delta) says "The row of the active interface language MUST be marked by the accent border and a check icon at its end, like the checked option of the theme group." The change removes that mark from the theme group: design.md D1 says "`Check` is no longer imported by the option group", and D4 says the checked option becomes `bg-accent text-accent-foreground` and "This replaces the check icon for the option group." NG3 keeps the language group unchanged. After archiving, the stable spec would tie the language row to a theme mark that no longer exists. That is the same stale-cross-reference defect R1 raises for the credit, but the report has no finding for it. The Consistency section lists only the credit contradiction, R1's Fix restates only the Gnomish Factory credit requirement, and the Verdict says "Everything else is ready to implement". The report should add a finding (or extend R1) asking for a MODIFIED Interface language choice in the delta with wording only, e.g. "marked by the accent border and a check icon at its end" with the "like the checked option of the theme group" comparison dropped, plus a matching What Changes bullet in proposal.md.
